name: Seedkin
about:
Seedkin turns any string into a pixel avatar, the same one every time, on any machine, with nothing stored: a robot, an animal, a person, a monster or a sprite. It is a zero-dependency TypeScript package that returns an SVG string.

The mark is the first Seedkin ever drawn: Botling jolly-sprocket-65, the robot from the site header, in its 9x9 small drawing so it keeps a face at 16 px.
construction: A 10 × 10 unit tile with corner radius 2.2 units; the robot is the package’s own 9x9 small Botling drawing, one unit a cell, drawn by the library and never by hand.
